items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The notice was given to the post on 27.02.2026. Under the statutory rule of §122 Abs. 2 AO a letter from a German tax authority is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after being posted (the letter itself incorrectly states the fourth day, see warning): 27.02.2026 + 3 days = 02.03.2026 (Monday, not a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday in Hessen, so no shift is needed). The one-month Einspruchsfrist begins the day after Bekanntgabe under §108 Abs. 1 AO in conjunction with §187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. on 03.03.2026, and ends under §188 Abs. 2 BGB with the expiry of the day of the following month that bears the same number as the day of Bekanntgabe (02.03.2026), i.e. 02.04.2026. 02.04.2026 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in Hessen (Karfreitag falls on 03.04.2026), so no further shift applies. Because the letter's own stated rule ('vierter Tag') would instead give 03.03.2026 as Bekanntgabe and 03.04.2026 as the deadline, the earlier, legally correct date (02.04.2026) is used to be safe.

items.title: Tax refund (Erstattung) credited to bank account
items.quote: Der Betrag wird Ihrem Konto gutgeschrieben.
items.computation: The assessment sets a refund of 550,00 € to be credited to the taxpayer's account, but no specific credit date is stated anywhere in the letter, so no exact due date can be determined; this typically follows automatically within a few weeks of the assessment but is not a deadline the recipient must act on.

warnings: The letter states that it is deemed delivered on the 'vierten Tag' (fourth day) after posting, but the statutory rule under §122 Abs. 2 AO provides for the 'dritten Tag' (third day); this discrepancy affects the exact start of the one-month Einspruch period, so the earlier (legally correct) date was used for the deadline and it should be verified, e.g. by checking the actual envelope postmark/receipt date.
